A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Blurry-Edges study, including the complete eight-page supplement. Text, equations, tables and figures are readable and can be matched directly.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic depth-estimation experiments, real-camera measurements, and supplementary ablations and calibration results, including Table 3, Figure 9 and Sections S6–S7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original synthetic and real-camera results, including Table 3, Figure 9 and the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The reported depth-conversion formula used for inference is corrected in Eq. (7), changing factors of the lens–sensor distance s. The architecture, losses, compositing equations and densification procedures remain unchanged. This establishes a correction to the specified inference formula, without establishing an implementation change or rerun.

E1.justification: Both retain basic-shape training, Painting/MS-COCO synthetic testing, larger-image evaluation and real-camera testing. Section 4.2 changes 'squares' to 'rectangles,' consistent with rectangular shapes already illustrated in the unchanged Figure 6(a); this does not establish expanded data or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains Focal Track, Tang et al., PhaseCam3D, DefocusNet, DFV-DFF and DEReD. Comparator membership in Tables S5–S6 and the DEReD training adaptation in Section S5 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported splits, sample counts, noise settings, optical parameters, training budgets, patch sizes, metrics, masking and calibration procedures match. Changing 'patches' to 'patch samples' preserves the same 16,000/4,000 local-stage crop counts.

E4.justification: The patch-size ablation in Table 2/Figure 7, weight-scheduling ablation in Tables S3–S4, and sparse-mask comparison in Section S6.3 are retained without changes. No new robustness analysis or case study is introduced.

E5.justification: Figure S8 retains the same mean-depth curves and standard-deviation bands. Neither version adds or revises seed information, repeated-training-run counts, confidence intervals or significance-testing practices.

E6.justification: Numerical tables and qualitative results match throughout the main paper and supplement. For example, Table 3 retains RMSE values of 5.281 cm for Ours and 3.992 cm for Ours-PP. The equation correction is not accompanied by revised empirical outcomes.

T1.justification: Eq. (7) replaces the denominator term Σ²s²(ρ₊−ρ₋)(ρ₊+ρ₋−2) with Σ²s(ρ₊−ρ₋)(sρ₊+sρ₋−2), restoring algebraic consistency with Eq. (6). This is a localized mathematical correction; the assumptions and supplementary derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same representation, closed-form depth relation, neural architecture, synthetic-to-real generalization claim and photon-limited accuracy claims. No principal contribution is added, removed or strengthened.

C2.justification: Interpretations of patch-size trade-offs, balanced loss scheduling and the dependence of dense-map quality on boundary density are unchanged. Section S6.6 and Figure S9 retain the exception where Tang et al. performs better in the first scene at SS+. No substantive limitation is added.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 corrects the documented training primitives from squares to rectangles and clarifies the crops as 'patch samples.' This refines the data-generation description. Architecture tables, hyperparameters, hardware, calibration instructions and stated code/data access remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 47 main references and two supplementary references are retained. Positioning relative to analytical and learning-based depth-from-defocus methods and field-of-junctions representations is unchanged.

P1.justification: Limited edits replace 'alpha clipping' with 'alpha compositing,' refine the training-data wording and correct equation punctuation. Section organization and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2's caption changes to 'alpha compositing,' accompanied by small text and equation reflow. Figure content, table structures, panels, plots and their placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects an algebraic error in the central depth equation, making Eq. (7) consistent with Eq. (6), and improves compositing and training-data terminology. These limited corrections improve mathematical accuracy and reproducibility. The empirical evidence, reported results and substantive discussion remain unchanged.
